name: Setsugekka
message: 「Miyako-chan, you’re really going home？ You could stay with us until we graduate, you know!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hehe, thank you, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s all so sudden. You could have stayed a little longer, you know…」

name: Miyako
message: 「I wanted to, but Tsubaki would get lonely.」

name: Iori
message: 「Did your father apologize properly？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, he said he was sorry.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that’s good.」
Apparently, there had been contact from Momiji’s father a few days ago, and Miyako-chan had decided to return home.
Since the car to pick her up would be arriving soon, Momiji, Setsugekka, and I decided the three of us would go out to greet Masatane.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah~ I’m gonna miss you~ Why don't you just become my little sister instead？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I wouldn’t mind having another big sister.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hold on, Miyako, don’t you have enough of a big sister with me already！？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm, I was only able to live in Big Sister’s room because Setsugekka-san cleaned it up for me.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Otherwise, I might have ended up living in Setsugekka-san’s room, maybe？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I taught you all sorts of things as your big sister, you know. Right? Miyako-chan?」

name: Miyako
message: 「If anything, wasn't I the one teaching you, Setsugekka-san？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that’s right.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s not true~！ Come on, Miyako-chan, let’s do that thing！ We won’t be able to once you go home, you know？」

name: Miyako
message: 「That thing…？ Oh, I get it！ You mean that thing？」
They look at each other and giggle knowingly.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here we go, one, two！」

name: Setsugekka & Miyako
message: 「Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Pfft！？ What kind of stupid things are you teaching her！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I told her it’s useful for when you really need to get Momimomi to listen to you~」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’m glad she taught me that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Whatever you do, don't say that in front of my family or my father, okay？ Secchan, just you wait！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nope, nope, I didn't do anything wroooong.」
While she was fooling around like that, it seemed our ride had arrived.

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, here they are.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can see the family crest of the archenemy Suzakuin family！ No doubt about it！」
The car pulled up and the door opened. A small shadow immediately came running out.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Big sisterrrrr！！」

name: Miyako
message: 「There, there... Tsubaki, have you been a good girl？」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Yeah! I missed you so much! You won't run away from home again, right？」
She had sprinted over at full speed and was clinging to Miyako. Watching the happy sisters warmed my heart.
Children are unconditionally cute. And that's just fine.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, so cute! I really want one for myself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you want one that badly, why don't you ask that man？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That old guy？ Alright, I'll go ask!」

name: Iori
message: 「No, don't, Setsugekka! Do you even know who that is?」
The person Momiji had pointed to was the one who had just stepped out of the car—the current head of the Suzakuin family, Mr. Masatane Suzakuin.

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, offer your respects.」
Anyone involved in Jindou would surely know him. Setsugekka was a bit questionable, but... We greeted him with a simple, high-ranking salute.

name: Masatane
message: 「Please, be at ease. We are not in a public setting right now.」
A low, commanding voice echoed. I knew his name, of course, but this was my first time meeting him in person.

name: Masatane
message: 「You are Momiji's homeroom teacher, I presume?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, I am Muragaki Iori, and I am in charge of her instruction.」

name: Masatane
message: 「Ho...！ So, that's the Muragaki I've heard of. I see.」
As expected of the head of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association, he would certainly know. I could only hope that none of my ancestors had left behind a grudge.

name: Masatane
message: 「I hear you are providing Momiji with good guidance. I look forward to your continued support.」

name: Iori
message: 「You are too kind. I will do my absolute best.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Big sisters, thank you for bringing Miyako back to us♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come visit anytime! Oh, and I'd be even happier if Tsubaki-chan came along too~」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Yay!♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka-san, please don’t egg her on too much, okay？」
Tsubaki-chan looks so happy being patted by Setsugekka. Ugh, if only I weren’t in front of Masatane-shi…！

name: Miyako
message: 「It’s alright, I’ll come over to play with Tsubaki again next time.」

name: Masatane
message: 「We’re only just about to head home… and you’re already talking about the next visit.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha…」
Masatane-shi is understandably giving a sour look.

name: Masatane
message: 「…Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, Father. Is something the matter？」

name: Masatane
message: 「The Murakumo Martial Festival is soon. You do understand, don’t you?」

name: Masatane
message: 「Murakumo is our backyard… therefore, failing to take the top spot here would be a disgrace to the Suzakuin name.」

name: Masatane
message: 「As the eldest daughter, you bear the responsibility of leading the vanguard and making the world realize that the Suzakuin family still reigns supreme.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I understand, Father. You have no need to worry. I will certainly live up to your expectations.」

name: Masatane
message: 「Very well. I’m counting on you.」
Masatane-shi nods in satisfaction. Momiji stares back, not flinching in the slightest.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Good luck, Momiji-oneechan！」

name: Miyako
message: 「We’re rooting for you, Oneechan.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, thank you.」
Fervent expectations and encouragement are showered upon her by her younger sisters. She gives them a firm nod.

name: Masatane
message: 「Now, let’s be off. Thank you all for your hospitality.」
The car they boarded slowly begins to pull away. Tsubaki-chan and Miyako-chan are waving from the window.
Everyone waves back in response.

name: Miyako
message: 「Thank you, Oneechan！ See you later~」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「I’ll come watch the Martial Festival！ See ya, Oneecha~n！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Bye-bye, Miyako-chan！ Tsubaki-chan！ I’m definitely going to crush Momimomi！」
After seeing Miyako-chan off and returning to the classroom, I was pelted with questions by Asahi and Ririmu.
Once I explained the situation in detail…

name: Asahi
message: 「Momiji-san’s father is a very strict man, isn’t he…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Even so, seriously？ What was with the way he said that！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Man, he's just like my parents！ Literally the worst of the worst.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, yeah, though he's always been like that.」
Momiji smiles wryly at Ririmu's indignation.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, Father does have a point. The martial families only exist because of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association. And Suzakuin is its linchpin.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uhhh, yeah... Well, I guess that's true...」

name: Momiji
message: 「If we lose that linchpin, chaos and upheaval will break out immediately. And someone will be sacrificed...」

name: Momiji
message: 「The Spirit Agency, the Cabinet, all sorts of other organizations... There are people everywhere waiting for an opening to exploit.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If the organization falls apart and we start fighting among ourselves, there'll be no room left for Jindou.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's why we have to project our authority in every direction. And that's my duty, you see.」
Once again, I'm reminded of the crucial responsibility Suzakuin bears.

name: Momiji
message: 「That's why I'm going to become Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「No matter... who stands in my way, I have no choice but to keep moving forward.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji...」
A faint light dwells in Momiji's eyes as she looks back. With the setting sun behind her, she stands carrying something immense.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, you know, I guess it really is impossible for all of us to hold hands and become Toujinegi together.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, working hard together like this... right now, I think it wasn't so bad after all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So I'll go ahead and say it... Thank you, everyone. Still, I won't hold back in our matches.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, you're right. We all feel the exact same way about refusing to lose, don't we？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Indeed. Our responsibilities may not be as heavy as yours, Momiji-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, feelings cannot be measured by size. I don't believe ours are inferior to yours in the slightest, Momiji-san.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I love this kind of thing! That's exactly why we can fight with everything we've got!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Heh, bring it on!」
It's precisely because we know we can't lose that we can fight. Just as Setsugekka said, that's the kind of battle this is.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, everyone. Once the new week starts, it's finally time for the Martial Festival preliminaries！」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, watch out for injuries and avoid over-exerting yourselves during practice. Make sure to get plenty of rest！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, teacher！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Roger that！」
Soon, the battle to reach the pinnacle of the academy will begin. No one knows the outcome yet.
One thing is for certain: it’s undoubtedly going to be intense.
I felt anticipation and excitement surging at the scent of the coming battle.
